 CLYBURN WINS 2026 (WIS) By WIS News 10 Staff Published : Nov. 3, 2026 at 8:40 PM EST | Updated : Nov. 3, 2026 at 8:54 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google NOTE: The above video is a livestream of WIS featuring current newscasts, Soda City Living and Gray Media’s Local News Live. 
 COLUMBIA, S.C. (WIS) - Longtime Democrat Rep. Jim Clyburn has been elected for what will be his 18 th term in the United States House of Representatives. 
 Clyburn defeated Republican challenger John Peterson in Tuesday’s general election for the state’s sixth congressional district. 
 He has served in the U.S. House since first being elected in 1993.
